description: Merge properties into one element of a freeform canvas by element id (move it, recolor it, change its text). Unknown ids error and name the canvas. The open console canvas streams the change live.

element_id.description: Element id to update (from element::add or element::list).

id.description: Stable 8-character canvas id (format must be freeform).

props.description: Properties to merge into the element. `null` values remove the key.
